AboutUs.title: About Us
AboutUs.description: EituEbenezer is an international Pentecostal evangelical Christian university dedicated to sharing the love of Christ and transforming lives through the power of the Holy Spirit.
AboutUs.historyText: What was once known as Maranatha Bible Seminary, Inc., founded in 1973, has today become EituEbenezer Theological College and University, Inc. It was established in 2015 as the official body of the Christian Education Department of the EituEbenezer Pentecostal Council, Inc., to bring Theological Education to a higher level of academic excellence.
AboutUs.missionText: Our mission is to train men and women who pursue a life of service to the Lord through the biblical standards of the Christian faith. This will be achieved by providing our students with a higher, multidimensional and pluralistic Christian theological education.
AboutUs.visionText: To strive to be a model institution that will contribute to the betterment of our society, training specialized and spiritual Christian leaders who will carry out our mission by promoting moral values based on the biblical foundations of the Christian faith.

cta.title: Would you like to join our team?
cta.description: If you feel God's call to serve in ministry, we would love to hear your testimony and how we can work together for the glory of God.

1.description: God has allowed me to develop as a worship minister, and to be a student and teacher at our institution for more than 10 years. I am convinced that in God's heart, EITU is exactly what our motto declares: The ministerial school of approved workers.

2.description: I am deeply committed to the mission of Ebenezer International Theological University, and I firmly believe in the vision of preparing, training, and empowering individuals for service in the Kingdom of God.

3.description: If I had to recommend anything, it would be this university, because it is incredible. I love what I have learned and the wonderful unity found within it. I love every aspect of this university, and it has helped me build my foundations.

4.description: At the university, God has called me to be a Professor and Director of the Chaplaincy department. The greatest calling is to be a servant of the Most High God. EITU has been a great blessing to me.

5.position: A leader with a vision of eternity.
5.description: Pastor and teacher at Ebenezer University. 16 years on the council, with passion and divine guidance. Master's degree in Administration and currently pursuing a Master's degree in Educational Management to strengthen the institution. I leave a legacy that transcends generations, promoting the Great Commission. Glory to Jesus Christ!

Testimonials.title: Testimonials
Testimonials.description: Listen to the stories of transformation and how God has worked in the lives of our members.

1.content: EituEbenezer has been a place where I found my purpose in Christ. The community here is truly a family that has supported me through the hardest moments of my life.

2.content: Watching God transform the lives of young people through our ministry is an incredible experience. Every day I see the power of the gospel in action.

3.content: When I arrived at EituEbenezer, I was lost and without direction. Today I can say that I have found my identity in Christ and a clear purpose for my life.

4.content: Being part of the missions team has allowed me to see how God works in different cultures and contexts. It's an experience that has transformed my perspective on the gospel.

intro.heading: 1. Introduction
intro.text: At EituEbenezer Pentecostal Evangelical Christian University (hereinafter, "EituEbenezer"), we value and respect the privacy of our visitors, members, collaborators and website users. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store and protect your personal data. By using our website or sharing your data with us, you accept the terms of this policy.

dataCollected.heading: 2. Data we collect
items: Full name
Email address
Phone number
Mailing address (if applicable)
Contact information for activities, events or donations
Messages sent through contact forms
Technical data such as IP address, browser type and site usage statistics (cookies)

purpose.heading: 3. Purpose of data processing
items: Managing communication with our members and visitors
Sending newsletters, devotionals and event announcements
Managing records of activities, meetings, services and worship gatherings
Managing donations and issuing receipts when applicable
Responding to requests or questions made by users
Improving the browsing experience on our website

legalBasis.heading: 4. Legal basis for data processing
items: Express consent of the data subject
Compliance with legal or tax obligations
EituEbenezer's legitimate interest for pastoral, administrative or communication purposes

sharing.heading: 5. Data sharing
sharing.intro: EituEbenezer does not sell, rent or share personal data with third parties, except in the following cases:
items: When required by law or by a competent authority
With technology service providers who help us operate the website (for example, hosting or email delivery), always under confidentiality agreements
With your explicit consent

cookies.heading: 6. Cookies and similar technologies
cookies.text: Our website may use cookies to improve navigation and gather anonymous usage statistics. You can configure your browser to block or delete cookies at any time.

rights.heading: 7. User rights
items: Access your personal data
Rectify inaccurate or incomplete data
Request the deletion of your data when it is no longer necessary
Object to processing or request its limitation
Withdraw your consent at any time
rights.contactText: To exercise these rights, you can contact us through the email

retention.heading: 8. Data retention
retention.text: We will retain your personal data only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes described and to comply with applicable legal obligations.

security.heading: 10. Data security
security.text: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal data against loss, misuse, unauthorized access, disclosure or destruction.

changes.heading: 11. Changes to this policy
changes.text: We reserve the right to modify this Privacy Policy at any time. Changes will be posted on this same page along with their update date.

siteUse.heading: 1. Use of the website
siteUse.text1: The website of EituEbenezer Pentecostal Evangelical Christian University is intended to share information about our activities, Christian teachings, and spiritual content.
siteUse.text2: Use of this site implies acceptance of these Terms of Service.

contentOwnership.heading: 2. Content ownership
contentOwnership.text: All published content (text, images, videos, audio, documents) belongs to EituEbenezer, unless otherwise indicated. Its reproduction or distribution without prior authorization is prohibited, especially for commercial purposes.

properUse.heading: 3. Proper use
properUse.text: Use of this site is expected to be respectful and in line with Christian principles. Use of the content for mockery, defamation, or any purpose contrary to the faith and values we promote is not permitted.

externalLinks.heading: 4. External links
externalLinks.text: This site may include links to external pages. We are not responsible for the content of third-party sites.

contact.heading: 5. Contact
contact.intro: For any inquiries regarding the use of the site, you can contact us at:

changes.heading: 6. Changes to these terms
changes.text: We may modify these Terms at any time. Modifications will be posted on this same page along with their update date.
